buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE 50% : The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up to 50 percent at the time of issue of the contract. However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 50 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 50 percent with the consent of the service provider 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC

Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. The seller is liable to disburse the statutory bonus to all eligible deployed staff as per Bonus Act 1965 annually or monthly (within the statutory time line) and claim for re-imbursement from the buyer upon sub mission of concrete digital proofs like Form 'C' (Bonus register) and bank disbursement sheet. In this conne ction, attention is invited to the Government of India, Ministry of Defence(Finance) letter No 231/(8)/DFPDS /Misc dated 29 Jul 2025. 2. If the buyer wishes to continue the services of the existing contract, it will be done on fulfilment of the following conditions and as per GeM rules :- (a) Mutual Agreement :- The buyer reserves the right to extend the existing contract beyond the initial vali dity period for an additional duration of upto six (06) months. Any extension shall be strictly on the same t erms and conditions and SLA of the original contract and subject to mutual written consent between buyer and service provider. (b) Notice Period :- The buyer shall provide a written notice of intend to extend the contract at least 60 d ays prior to the current contract expiration date. The service provider shall convey their acceptance or rej ection of the extension in the Company letter head within 15 days of receiving the notice. (c) Pricing :- The rates applicable during the extended period shall revised as per Government of India, Mi nistry of Labour and Employment, Office of the Chief Labour Commissioner notification issued from time to time. .
